783-2645-3430-4644.easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-2645-3430-4644.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3175-6798-8207.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

141-3905-3967.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3905-3967.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha, Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

132-1379-4687-5527.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1379-4687-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
132-1379-4687-5527.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Five Hundred Year Diary's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.
132-1379-4687-5527.notes: This combo only produces infinite mana if you control at least four Clues.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5567-6254-8095--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5567-6254-8095--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-1746-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Accomplished Automaton.
When Accomplished Automaton dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Accomplished Automaton enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4247-7084-7892.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

252-1115-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-1115-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1624-4838-7439.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast a copy of Channel from exile by paying {G}{G}, unpreparing Yavimaya Bloomsage.
Use Channel's ability by paying 1 life, adding {C}.
Repeat step 2 until you have exactly 1 life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-7296.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

2781-3817-4605.description:
Cast Sister Hospitaller by paying its mana cost.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking another permanent you control.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking the nontoken Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 3.

250-779-1168-1479-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1168-1479-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

480-997-6981-7077.description:
Cast Illicit Masquerade by paying {3}{B}. When it enters, its first ability triggers, putting an impostor counter on Skullbriar.
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Skullbriar.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Skullbriar.
When Skullbriar dies, Illicit Masquerade's second ability and Skullbriar's ability granted to it by Perigee Beckoner trigger.
Resolve the Skullbriar trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Illicit Masquerade trigger, failing to exile Skullbriar as it has left your graveyard and returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3967-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
3967-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

1170-1329-3518-6912.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Lion's Eye Diamond.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Flash Thompson.
When Flash Thompson enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4067-6609-6822.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6609-6822.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

328-5147-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-5147-5220-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1247-3053-3918.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two basic land types among lands you control
1247-3053-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color(s).
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

880-2907-6763.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2907-6763.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2034-3174-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Switcheroo.
2034-3174-5434-5555.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

883-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
883-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2292-3055-3175.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

360-1981-2397-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 50.
360-1981-2397-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Reservoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating fifty 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1558-1770-4428-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

3652-4050-4871-5222.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Realms attached to Ornithopter.
3652-4050-4871-5222.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter, adding {1}.
When Ornithopter dies, Sword of the Realms and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sword of the Realms trigger, returning Ornithopter to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

92-3392-3591.description:
Activate Vizkopa Guildmage's second ability by paying {1}{W}{B}, causing each opponent to lose life whenever you gain life this turn.
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 2 until you have 1 life.
Activate Children of Korils by sacrificing it, causing you to gain life equal to the amount of life you've lost this turn.
Vizkopa Guildmage triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the amount of life you gained.

2363-2393-2399.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Colfenor and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1869-2034-2721.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Inalla trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer's trigger, doing nothing.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Inalla trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
